name: ModelVariant97_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant97_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a full-screen flash fades in, a flickering glow fan pulses around a model part, eight shards fade in one after another around that part and then fly in front of the slot while spinning, and a textured fan grows there last); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the start delay, 1 once at the hit, 2 after the fan time and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-114 and 244 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
